check.limitations: Live broadcast metadata does not prove current footage or animal activity. Device/iframe playback untested.

prior_research.evidence: Two frames 40 s apart at about 10:35 PDT. Wide flooded marsh under a broken cloud sky, tule islands splitting the water. Well over a hundred ducks and shorebirds are on the water with more birds in flight above the treeline; the tight raft at bottom left has spread and individual birds have swum clear between frames. An earlier pair caught the camera at a different pan position with a white egret in a channel, which shows it is a PTZ that repositions on its own.
prior_research.notes: This is a PTZ, so the framing changes on its own schedule and a 90 second visit may land mid-move. That is a feature here: the movement plus the bird numbers means something is always happening. Coordinates estimated to Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge near Willows in Glenn County. Dark after sunset.
